title: Fitness App PRD

overview.summary: A mobile fitness application that helps users set goals, track workouts, monitor progress, and stay motivated through personalised plans and social features.
overview.problem: People struggle to maintain consistent fitness habits due to lack of structured guidance, poor progress visibility, and low accountability. Existing apps are either too complex for beginners or too limited for intermediate users.
targetAudience: Adults aged 18–45 looking to improve general fitness
Beginners who need guided workout plans
Intermediate users who want to track and optimise performance
Busy professionals who need flexible, time-efficient routines

goals: Enable users to create and follow personalised workout plans
Provide clear, motivating progress tracking over time
Reduce drop-off rate by surfacing streaks, milestones, and reminders
Support both gym-based and home/bodyweight workouts
Deliver a simple onboarding experience that works for beginners
nonGoals: Nutrition tracking or meal planning (out of scope for v1)

userStories.goal: complete an onboarding flow that captures my fitness level and goals
userStories.benefit: so that I receive a workout plan suited to me from day one

userStories.goal: browse and select from a library of workout plans
userStories.benefit: so that I can find a routine that fits my schedule and equipment

userStories.goal: log a completed workout with sets, reps, and weights
userStories.benefit: so that I have an accurate record of my training history

userStories.goal: view a dashboard showing my progress over the past weeks
userStories.benefit: so that I can see improvement and stay motivated

userStories.goal: receive push notifications reminding me of scheduled workouts
userStories.benefit: so that I maintain consistency even on busy days

userStories.goal: create a custom workout by selecting exercises from a library
userStories.benefit: so that I can tailor sessions to my specific needs

userStories.goal: view exercise instructions with descriptions and demonstration images
userStories.benefit: so that I perform movements safely and correctly

userStories.goal: set weekly workout frequency goals and track my streak
userStories.benefit: so that I build a sustainable long-term habit

features.name: Onboarding & Goal Setup
features.description: A multi-step onboarding flow capturing fitness level (beginner / intermediate / advanced), primary goal (weight loss, muscle gain, general fitness, endurance), available equipment, and weekly availability. Outputs a recommended plan.

features.name: Workout Plan Library
features.description: A curated library of pre-built plans organised by goal, duration, and equipment required. Each plan includes a structured week-by-week schedule.

features.name: Exercise Library
features.description: A searchable and filterable database of exercises with name, muscle groups targeted, equipment needed, step-by-step instructions, and static demonstration images.

features.name: Workout Logger
features.description: In-session logging of sets, reps, and weight (or time/distance for cardio). Supports rest timers and the ability to swap exercises mid-session.

features.name: Progress Dashboard
features.description: Visual charts showing workout frequency, volume over time, and personal records (PRs) per exercise. Includes a weekly summary and streak counter.

features.name: Custom Workout Builder
features.description: Allows users to build and save their own workouts by picking exercises from the library and specifying sets, reps, and rest periods.

features.name: Notifications & Reminders
features.description: Configurable push notifications for scheduled workouts, streak reminders, and milestone celebrations.

features.name: User Profile & Settings
features.description: Profile page showing goals, current plan, stats summary, and settings for units (kg/lbs), notification preferences, and account management.

features.name: Achievements & Milestones
features.description: Badge system rewarding users for hitting streaks, completing plans, and setting new personal records to drive engagement and motivation.

features.name: Social / Community Feed
features.description: Optional social layer allowing users to share completed workouts, follow friends, and give kudos — deferred to v1.1 pending user research validation.

successMetrics.metric: Average workouts logged per active user per week

assumptions: Users have a smartphone with iOS 15+ or Android 10+
Core functionality is available offline with sync on reconnection
Content (exercises, plans) is managed via a CMS by an internal team
Authentication will be handled via email/password and social login (Google, Apple)
openQuestions: Should v1 include a freemium model with a premium subscription tier, or launch as fully free?
What is the target exercise library size at launch (e.g. 100, 250, 500 exercises)?
Is there a specific design system or brand identity to align to?
Are there accessibility requirements (e.g. WCAG 2.1 AA compliance)?
What analytics platform will be used for tracking engagement metrics?
